objective: Migrate the measured double-inverted-pendulum MATLAB LQR to the existing PendulumLab C++ hardware project with a one-command experiment workflow.

known.hardware: NI PCI-6602 plus Advantech PCI-1723 AO0 on the existing cart
known.cart_encoder: Dev1/ctr0; raw count decreases toward +x; 33259 counts over 0.734 m
known.first_encoder: Dev1/ctr1; X4; 8000 counts/rev; raw count increases when the first tip moves toward +x
known.second_encoder: Dev1/ctr2; X4; 4000 counts/rev; relative joint encoder; raw count increases toward +x
known.safe_shutdown: AO0=0 V followed by Servo OFF

acceptance_tests: Existing phase1 C++ regression suite passes
Double-pendulum controller sign, absolute-angle composition, finite output, and voltage saturation tests pass
The executable validates config without creating hardware output tasks
A supervised run automatically homes, waits for Enter at center, runs LQR, and saves telemetry and metrics
attempted_changes: Added a third PCI-6602 counter task for the second pendulum encoder with 10 us A/B filtering
Added a parameterized six-state double-pendulum LQR and acceleration-to-voltage cascade
Added a standalone guided hardware experiment executable and one-click launcher
Added immutable per-run config, telemetry, and deterministic metrics artifacts
Added a simulation-verified known-good parameter snapshot
outcomes: All existing and new unit tests passed
Config-only executable validation passed with the MATLAB gain vector
unresolved_blockers: The new second-encoder C++ path and full automatic-home/LQR sequence require the first supervised physical run
The MATLAB gain set remains simulation-verified until hardware telemetry demonstrates stable operation
